device.name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

protocol.relevance: data/limit-small/qrels.jsonl, exactly 2 gold documents per query
protocol.recall: macro-average over queries of |gold ∩ top-k| / |gold|. percent = 100 * fraction.
protocol.tie_break: higher cosine first; equal cosine broken by ascending document id
protocol.drowning: corpus = all 46 limit-small documents, followed by a nested prefix of numpy Generator(seed=0).permutation of the 50000 full-corpus rows. Added sizes 0, 100, 1000, 10000, 50000.
protocol.document_text: title + text, titles are empty so this is the text field
protocol.query_text: raw query text, no instruction prefix

lexical_content_word_baseline.description: Rank the 46 documents by how many attribute content words they share. Equal counts break by ascending document id. This is a CPU check, included in wall time.

dataset_facts.note: Content-word containment is counted only when the attribute has at least one alphanumeric token longer than 3 characters. Attributes with no such token are listed separately. Empty attribute word sets do not count as a match.

diagnostic.selection: numpy Generator(0).choice without replacement, then sorted
diagnostic.content_word: alphanumeric token of length > 3, lowercased. Compared between the query attribute (text inside 'Who likes ...?') and the top-ranked non-gold document.

diagnostic_full_pool_summary.corpus: 46 limit-small documents plus all 50000 full-corpus documents
